selectionBasis: Revisit exactly the 48 retain-hold rows from the previous independent next-60 screen under the user plain rule: teach ordinary reusable collocations/constructions; hold only on concrete wording/sense defects; no automatic exclusion for non-idiom status.
guardrails: These are read-only recommendations. No editorial decision, selected lesson, exclusion register, audio or public release changed.
A teachable new-owner recommendation needs a full seven-step lesson, source-faithful target pattern, answer/glossary/originality checks, and independent review before selection.
The 2407 alias is conditional on immediate-not-simultaneous interpretation and matching the full source sentence.
Source wording defects require an explicit correction record and source/model separation rather than silent normalization.

rows.expression: phone stops being a simple contact device
rows.exactGuideSentence: The phone stops being a simple contact device when games dominate its use.
rows.guideMeaning: A natural contrast showing how a tool's role expands; useful in a qualified answer.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The phone changes role when games dominate; stop being a simple X is a reusable change-of-role construction.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach expanded function without implying phones cease all contact use.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A simple line can land a punch in the final verse.
rows.guideMeaning: Have a strong impact; a fixed boxing metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: A lyric line can land a punch in the figurative impact sense; the boxing-to-art transfer supports multiple contexts.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Model figurative impact and distinguish pack a punch; review how natural the line-as-agent example sounds.

rows.expression: the whole city is humming the same tune
rows.exactGuideSentence: By summer, the whole city is humming the same tune.
rows.guideMeaning: Many people share an interest in one song; a musical image.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The entire city humming the same tune uses city metonymy and a transferable shared-song image.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Keep literal shared song interest distinct from the agree-with-each-other sense of sing the same tune.

rows.expression: a first alert rather than a final answer
rows.exactGuideSentence: Treat the post as a first alert rather than a final answer.
rows.guideMeaning: A concise contrast between early notice and verified explanation; a useful media-literacy pattern.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: a first alert rather than a final answer
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The media-literacy contrast supplies a useful X rather than Y pattern for separating early signals from verified conclusions.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach the precise first-notice versus final-explanation boundary; do not call the full wording a fixed idiom.

rows.expression: impatient with the problem, but patient with the solution
rows.exactGuideSentence: Good engineers are impatient with the problem, but patient with the solution.
rows.guideMeaning: Urgently seek improvement while carefully developing it; a balanced contrast.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: impatient with X, but patient with Y
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The balanced adjective frame is reusable to express urgency about a problem alongside care in solving it.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Keep the positive balance; impatient with does not mean careless about the solution.

rows.expression: general plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision
rows.exactGuideSentence: The project taught us that general plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision.
rows.guideMeaning: A balanced contrast between broad direction and exact execution; a natural spoken way to qualify or connect ideas.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: good for X, but necessary for Y
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The source contrasts broad plans for momentum with detailed plans for precision; the two-purpose concession frame transfers to other planning contexts.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Retain good versus necessary strength and general versus detailed subjects in the lesson model.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Parents need to distinguish guidance and control.
rows.guideMeaning: A useful distinction between helping someone choose and choosing for them; a natural spoken way to qualify or connect ideas.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Distinguish A and B is a reusable contrast construction and the parental-choice boundary is teachable.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Do not flatten guidance into control; show advising versus deciding for someone.

rows.expression: the body was made to move
rows.exactGuideSentence: Even gentle walks remind us the body was made to move.
rows.guideMeaning: A memorable natural statement supporting regular activity; a natural spoken way to qualify or connect ideas.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: the body was made to move
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Be made to + verb describes designed or natural purpose, and the health sentence supplies a clear use.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Present this as a natural persuasive statement, not as a literal scientific proof or a fixed idiom.

rows.expression: move wisely than to push recklessly
rows.exactGuideSentence: After the injury, she learned it was better to move wisely than to push recklessly.
rows.guideMeaning: Choose safe activity over excessive effort; a balanced contrast.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: better to move wisely than to push recklessly
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The full source has a grammatical better to X than to Y comparison; the extracted fragment alone is incomplete.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Author from the full exact sentence while recording the span repair; do not teach move wisely than to as grammatical.

rows.expression: train the person, not just the body
rows.exactGuideSentence: A good academy aims to train the person, not just the body.
rows.guideMeaning: Develop wider education and wellbeing alongside sport; a precise contrast.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: train the person, not just the body
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Not just X frames a broader development goal beyond physical training and can transfer to education contexts.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Preserve person/body contrast; do not imply physical training is unimportant.

rows.expression: show the touch of the hand
rows.exactGuideSentence: Handmade seals show the touch of the hand.
rows.guideMeaning: Reveal human craftsmanship; a touch metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Show the touch of the hand is not a natural description of visible craftsmanship without clearer referent or attested collocation.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve whether the intended form is show the maker’s hand, show the human touch or bear the marks of handwork; none can silently replace the source.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Passengers want less fuss and more flow.
rows.guideMeaning: Fewer hassles and smoother movement; a rhythmic contrast.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Less X, more Y is a compact reusable request for fewer hassles and smoother movement.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Treat flow as smooth passenger movement, not emotional flow or a fixed proverb.

rows.expression: a free seat on a bad system is still a bad ride
rows.exactGuideSentence: A free seat on a bad system is still a bad ride for commuters.
rows.guideMeaning: Price alone does not make poor service attractive; a pointed transport phrase.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: a free seat on a bad system is still a bad ride
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The concessive X is still Y frame makes price-versus-quality reasoning reusable in service evaluation.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach the literal transport context first and mark the line as an authored argument, not an established idiom.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Travel safety means not mistaking convenience for invincibility.
rows.guideMeaning: Not assuming an easy system removes all risk; a figurative contrast.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Mistake X for Y is a standard reusable frame; the source warns against equating convenience with safety from all risk.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Preserve not mistaking as a caution and explain why convenience does not entail invincibility.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A quiet walk helped the group settle their mind before the test.
rows.guideMeaning: Calm their thoughts enough to concentrate; a natural mental-state collocation.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: A quiet walk calming thoughts before a test supports the reusable mental-state collocation settle one’s mind.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: The source has group/their mind number disagreement; preserve exact source provenance but write grammatical model sentences and log the correction.

rows.expression: one step ahead of the clock
rows.exactGuideSentence: Preparing tonight keeps us one step ahead of the clock tomorrow.
rows.guideMeaning: Better prepared than the time pressure demands; a vivid extension of being ahead.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: One step ahead of the clock extends the reusable preparedness pattern to time pressure.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach being prepared before a deadline; mark the clock object as creative rather than a mandatory fixed collocate.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Without a timetable, we spend the week running after it.
rows.guideMeaning: Trying unsuccessfully to catch up with time; a figurative image of pursuit.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Without a timetable, running after it has no clear it antecedent: timetable, week and time imply different meanings.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Get the intended referent and a natural full sentence before choosing run after, run behind or catch up.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A clear plan can sharpen your day.
rows.guideMeaning: Make a day's activities more focused and effective; sharpen is figurative.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Sharpen your day is not a stable or natural object pairing for sharpen, while sharpen focus would change the source.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve intended focus/plan meaning and authorize a target-form repair before modelling this expression.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Your carefully planned day can fall apart when constant alerts scatter it.
rows.guideMeaning: Break focus into unrelated pieces; a physical verb describes attention figuratively.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Scatter it lacks a clear referent and constant alerts are more naturally said to scatter attention than a planned day.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve whether it means scatter attention or disrupt the schedule; exact source target is presently unteachable.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Phones can be excellent servants during a busy workday.
rows.guideMeaning: Useful tools when kept under human control; a personification that contrasts with masters in context.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Calling phones excellent servants personifies a tool that helps when people remain in control.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: If paired with the good-servant/bad-master proverb, explain the missing masters contrast; do not make excellent a fixed word.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Without a map, we would set off half-blind.
rows.guideMeaning: Begin a journey with too little information; a figurative description of poor preparation.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Set off half-blind can express beginning with insufficient information, a reusable figurative journey frame.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Mark the source as a creative variant and distinguish it from literal poor vision and the separate go in blind idiom.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A written plan helped hold the day together.
rows.guideMeaning: Keep daily activities organised and manageable; an image of physical cohesion.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The written plan keeps daily tasks coherent, a transferable hold X together pattern.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Separate schedule coordination from personal emotional composure in hold it together.

rows.expression: walk out of the door too late
rows.exactGuideSentence: If you walk out of the door too late, no app can fix the delay.
rows.guideMeaning: Leave home after the time needed to be punctual; a natural spoken sequence.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: walk out of the door too late
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The departure-time phrase is ordinary but reusable spoken English for leaving after the necessary time.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach literal timing and causal effect on punctuality; do not advertise it as an idiom.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Without a timer, the afternoon can run away with you.
rows.guideMeaning: Become difficult to control, especially time or emotion; a conventional figurative phrase.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The afternoon can run away with you is a likely blend of time gets away from you and run away with an idea.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Verify intended idiom and pronoun roles before teaching; current wording risks an unnatural learner model.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Daily practice helped the runners hold their rhythm.
rows.guideMeaning: Maintain a stable pace or routine; rhythm is used beyond music.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Runners holding their rhythm supplies a natural maintain-pace collocation that transfers to repeated activity.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Start with literal athletic cadence and avoid claiming this source necessarily means an abstract routine.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The market may split in two directions over the next decade.
rows.guideMeaning: Develop along two different paths; a spatial image describes divergent trends.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The market may split in two directions awkwardly joins splitting with directional development.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve whether the guide means split into two segments or move in two directions; the original form lacks a clear stable model.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The editor chose to cut away the long introduction.
rows.guideMeaning: Remove an unnecessary section during editing; a useful phrasal verb.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: An editor can cut away unnecessary material; the source supports a removal sense of cut away.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Keep the object grammatical and distinguish cut away from film-camera cutaway and cut out.

rows.expression: unfold in a clear and purposeful order
rows.exactGuideSentence: The evidence began to unfold in a clear and purposeful order.
rows.guideMeaning: Develop step by step in an orderly sequence; unfold is figurative.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Evidence unfolding gradually is a usable figurative development verb despite an overlong modifier.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach development/revelation; do not claim the evidence itself purposely arranges its order. Existing owner 1437 focuses on quiet publicity, not this sequence.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The bright colours heighten life in the scene.
rows.guideMeaning: Make ordinary experience appear more intense; heighten is figurative.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The bright colours heighten life in the scene does not specify whether they intensify energy, realism, liveliness or the sense of life.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve the intended object before transferring heighten to a learner sentence; source wording is too unclear.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A chart is useful, but it is not the territory itself.
rows.guideMeaning: Only a representation, not the full reality; part of the map-territory metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: A chart is not the territory itself conveys the reusable map-versus-reality caution.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Teach representation versus reality using the full chart sentence; do not turn the fragment into a freestanding noun phrase.

rows.expression: the gap is probably smaller than stereotypes suggest
rows.exactGuideSentence: The gap is probably smaller than stereotypes suggest once we compare real choices.
rows.guideMeaning: Qualified comparison that resists an overgeneralisation; a useful precise spoken pattern.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The qualified comparison is reusable for challenging an overgeneralisation without denying all differences.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Keep probably and the measured-gap evidence; this is a natural argumentative construction, not an idiom.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The director used silence to tighten the screws.
rows.guideMeaning: Increase pressure or tension; a fixed mechanical metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The fixed expression is teachable as increasing pressure; the film source extends it to suspense.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Lead with interpersonal-pressure meaning and explicitly label the suspense use as creative extension, never as the default sense.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The sudden reveal made the tension snap.
rows.guideMeaning: A build-up of pressure breaking suddenly; a physical metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Made the tension snap may suggest release, break or sudden escalation, but the effect is unclear and the collocation is questionable.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve whether tension broke or snapped taut before any target or answer key.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The lights went out at once during the storm.
rows.guideMeaning: Suddenly, in one moment; a fixed time expression.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The guide defines at once as sudden/immediate; selected owner 3142 teaches immediate-after-trigger, whereas owner 048 teaches simultaneous actions.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: The lights going out can also imply simultaneous failure; confirm the intended single-event reading and full-source detector before aliasing.

rows.exactGuideSentence: I could feel the suspense in my bones during the final scene.
rows.guideMeaning: Suspense felt physically and intensely; an embodied expression.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Suspense in my bones is an unnatural variation of feel it in my bones, whose normal sense is intuition rather than felt suspense.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Resolve whether the speaker feels anticipation physically or predicts an outcome; do not attach to intuition owner blindly.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Smart systems may run the background of it while residents work.
rows.guideMeaning: Operate the less visible functions of a home; a computing metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Run the background of it has an unclear it object and is not the normal run in the background construction.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Identify the home functions or software process that runs before authoring.

rows.expression: convenience has started to replace capability
rows.exactGuideSentence: In some offices, convenience has started to replace capability.
rows.guideMeaning: A concise contrast between ease and retained skill; useful for qualified criticism.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: convenience has started to replace capability
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The source gives a reusable replace X with Y-style critique of skill loss through easy tools.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: This is a contextual claim, not a fixed idiom; explain started to as gradual change and avoid asserting all capability is lost.

rows.expression: playground or a puzzle to crack
rows.exactGuideSentence: To her, the new software was a playground or a puzzle to crack.
rows.guideMeaning: A space for experimentation or a challenge to solve; two images frame technology.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: The software can be approached as a puzzle to crack, a transferable challenge metaphor within the source’s two-image sentence.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Select this bounded phrase as the target; mention playground as alternate framing without requiring both in answer keys.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The habits were absorbed over time at school.
rows.guideMeaning: Taken in gradually through experience; absorbed is figurative.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Habits absorbed over time is a reusable figurative uptake/passive construction.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Explain gradual learning through experience; distinguish physical absorption and an intentional one-off lesson.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A patient explanation can make the topic open up.
rows.guideMeaning: Become accessible or understandable; a natural phrasal verb.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Make the topic open up is an awkward access-to-understanding use; existing owner 1576 is personal disclosure and does not cover it.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Repair the source wording or establish natural topic-open-up usage before selecting an owner; later exact repeat 2541 remains linked only as a candidate.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A calendar helps keep life running smoothly.
rows.guideMeaning: Help everyday routines function without trouble; a machinery metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Keep X running smoothly is a natural transferable function metaphor for routines.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Existing owner 1353 depends on the oil comparison and is narrower; do not alias without revising its sense/detector.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Without examples, the knowledge stays rather flat.
rows.guideMeaning: Information remains shallow without understanding; flat is figurative.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Knowledge stays rather flat is not a clear natural collocation for shallow understanding.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Determine whether the writer means flat explanation, superficial knowledge or stagnant progress; each gives a different target.

rows.exactGuideSentence: Basic safety steps should live in your head.
rows.guideMeaning: Be remembered rather than only stored externally; a spatial metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Safety steps living in your head expresses retained mental knowledge using a spatial metaphor.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Constrain to remembered instructions here; distinguish intrusive thoughts and earworm uses of live in your head.

rows.exactGuideSentence: The memory is a little blurry after many years.
rows.guideMeaning: Somewhat imprecise or unclear; a visual blur describes memory figuratively.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: A memory being a little blurry is ordinary but natural figurative English for imprecise recall.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Existing warm but blurry owner 1585 describes unclear communication; this memory sense is distinct.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A timeline and letters help records give it shape.
rows.guideMeaning: Documents provide structure and clarity; shape is figurative.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: A timeline and letters help records give it shape has unclear it and overlapping subjects, obscuring what receives shape.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Identify whether the target is give a story shape or records give shape to memory; preserve exact-source correction trail.

rows.expression: a constant tug on people's attention
rows.exactGuideSentence: Alerts can become a constant tug on people's attention.
rows.guideMeaning: An ongoing demand for focus; a physical pulling metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Alerts tugging at attention creates a reusable demand-on-focus image.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Keep continuous repeated alerts as cause; distinguish tug-of-war between competing duties.

rows.expression: a practical tool rather than just a toy
rows.exactGuideSentence: A basic phone can be a practical tool rather than just a toy.
rows.guideMeaning: Something useful for real tasks, beyond entertainment; a useful contrast phrase.
rows.boundedTargetOrOwner: a practical tool rather than just a toy
rows.sourceSpecificReason: Rather than just contrasts genuine utility with mere entertainment in a reusable evaluative frame.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Treat tool/toy as contextual phone labels; do not claim this full sentence is fixed idiom.

rows.exactGuideSentence: A phone helps children feel connected to home.
rows.guideMeaning: Still able to communicate with family; a connection metaphor.
rows.sourceSpecificReason: A phone helping children feel connected to home is natural, reusable emotional/communication language.
rows.sourceSenseBoundaryAndNextCheck: Explain that connection here is maintained family contact, not geographic proximity or an internet-link guarantee.
